title: DuoJEPA: Cross-Modal Translation Between Unaligned Self-Supervised Embedding Spaces
abstract: arXiv:2611.15968v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learning from paired modalities is commonly equated with aligning them: two encoders are trained until the embeddings of a pair coincide in a shared space. We study whether cross-modal retrieval and classification can instead be obtained while the two encoders' own embedding spaces remain directly unaligned. DuoJEPA trains one encoder per modality with the self-supervised LeJEPA objective and appends to each encoder a single transformer layer that translates its embedding into the other encoder's space, supervised by a contrastive objective computed entirely within that target space. No loss term compares the two own spaces directly, although the encoders are optimised jointly through the translation objective. translated_title: DuoJEPA：未对齐自监督嵌入空间之间的跨模态翻译
translated_abstract: 从成对的模态中学习通常被等同于对齐它们：训练两个编码器，直到一对样本的嵌入在共享空间中重合。我们研究是否可以在两个编码器各自的嵌入空间保持完全不对齐的情况下，仍然获得跨模态检索与分类能力。DuoJEPA 使用自监督的 LeJEPA 目标为每个模态训练一个编码器，并在每个编码器后附加单个 transformer 层，将其嵌入翻译到另一个编码器的空间中，该翻译由完全在目标空间内计算的对比目标进行监督。没有任何损失项直接比较两个编码器各自的空间，尽管编码器通过翻译目标被联合优化。在我们的实验中，翻译器的残差连接决定了跨模态压力被吸收的位置：使用带残差的翻译器时，两个编码器会直接对齐；而使用无跳连（无残差）的翻译器时，两个编码器各自的空间则保持不对齐。
tldr: DuoJEPA 提出在两个编码器的自监督嵌入空间保持不对齐的情况下，通过在每个编码器后附加单个 transformer 翻译层并在目标空间内施加对比监督来实现跨模态检索与分类，并发现翻译器的残差连接决定了跨模态压力是否会使两个空间直接对齐。
en_tdlr: DuoJEPA achieves cross-modal retrieval and classification while keeping the two encoders' self-supervised embedding spaces unaligned, by attaching a single transformer translation layer to each encoder supervised within the target space, with residual connections determining whether the own spaces end up directly aligned.
